description: A composite of spin-polarised density-of-states plots from first-principles (DFT) calculations for the Fe1-xMnxAl system. The caption names ten panels (a FeAl, b Fe0.875Mn0.125Al, c Fe0.75Mn0.25Al, d Fe0.625Mn0.375Al, e Fe0.5Mn0.5Al, f Fe0.375Mn0.625Al, g Fe, h Fe0.25Mn0.75Al, i Fe0.125Mn0.875Al, j MnAl), but only eight are supplied: (c)-(j), each labelled in its top-left corner with the exact composition. Every panel plots DOS / (States·eV-1·atom-1) on y (range about -2 to 2) against Energy / eV on x (-10 to 20), with a vertical dashed line at 0 eV marking the Fermi level. Panels (c)-(f) and (h)-(j) share one two-part legend: Up-states (solid black) with Up-Al-s, Up-Al-p, Up-Fe-d, Up-Mn-d partials, and Down-states (solid red) with the matching Down-Al-s, Down-Al-p, Down-Fe-d, Down-Mn-d partials. Panel (g) "Fe" is the exception: its legend lists only Up-Fe-s, Up-Fe-p, Up-Fe-d, Up-states and the corresponding Down- variants. In every panel a sharp DOS peak sits on the Fermi level, reaching about the y = 1 gridline in the up channel with a deeper negative counterpart in the down channel, formed essentially by hybridised Fe-d and Mn-d states with weak Al-p; the up and down channels are asymmetric, which the figure presents as the origin of metallic conduction and magnetic character.

observations.observation: Each supplied panel plots DOS / (States·eV-1·atom-1) versus Energy / eV over -10 to 20 eV, with a vertical dashed line at 0 eV marking the Fermi level.
In every panel the DOS curves are nonzero at the dashed Fermi-level line, with no gap around 0 eV, i.e. finite density of states at the Fermi level.
The caption states that the dashed vertical lines represent the Fermi level.
The citing text states that all these Fe-Mn-Al alloys have metallic features because they exhibit nonzero density of states (DOS) at the Fermi level.

Each panel carries a two-part legend with Up-states (solid black) and Down-states (solid red) totals plus Al-s, Al-p, Fe-d and Mn-d partial curves; panel (g) for Fe instead lists only Fe-s, Fe-p, Fe-d and the totals.

A single sharp DOS peak is pinned on the Fermi level in every panel, reaching about the y = 1 States·eV-1·atom-1 gridline in the up-state total curve, with a deeper negative peak in the down-state curve.
The citing text states that the up and down DOS curves near the Fermi level are divided into one sharp peak mainly and that the sharp peak is located on the Fermi level.
The sharp Fermi-level peak coincides in energy with the Fe-d and Mn-d partial-DOS maxima, whereas the Al-s and Al-p partial curves remain weak and broad across the same region.

Up-spin and down-spin total DOS are mirror-asymmetric about zero (positive up states, negative down states with different peak magnitudes), which the citing text interprets as magnetic character from the dissymmetric down and up states.

The citing text states that for FeAl the band range from -5 to 1 eV is contributed mainly by Al-p and Fe-d bands, for MnAl by Al-p and Mn-d bands, and for other Fe-Mn-Al alloys by Al-p, Fe-d and Mn-d bands together.
Beyond roughly +/-5 eV the total DOS curves oscillate with small amplitude close to zero out to 20 eV in all supplied panels.

Panel (g) is the only panel without Al or Mn partial-DOS contributions; its up-state total peak is the tallest of the supplied set, near the 1.8 gridline, and Fe-s/Fe-p are essentially zero over the plotted range.
Only panels (c)-(j) are present in the supplied image set; panels (a) FeAl and (b) Fe0.875Mn0.125Al named in the caption are not supplied.
The panel labels printed inside the frames are 'c Fe0.75Mn0.25Al', 'd Fe0.625Mn0.375Al', 'e Fe0.5Mn0.5Al', 'f Fe0.375Mn0.625Al', 'g Fe', 'h Fe0.25Mn0.75Al', 'i Fe0.125Mn0.875Al' and 'j MnAl'.

The caption states the figure shows calculated TDOS and PDOS for Fe and the Fe1-xMnxAl system; the citing text states the electron density distribution maps are shown separately in Fig. 4, not in this figure.

subfigures.description: Labelled 'c Fe0.75Mn0.25Al'. TDOS/PDOS vs Energy over -10 to 20 eV with dashed Fermi level at 0 eV; up-states (black) and down-states (red) with Al-s, Al-p, Fe-d and Mn-d partials; a sharp peak on the Fermi level, largest in the Fe-d and Mn-d partial curves.
Labelled 'd Fe0.625Mn0.375Al'. Same axes, legend and layout as (c); sharp Fermi-level peak with pronounced negative down-state dip and asymmetric up/down channels.
Labelled 'e Fe0.5Mn0.5Al'. Same layout; comparable Fermi-level peak height, Al-p band extending roughly from -5 to 1 eV.
Labelled 'f Fe0.375Mn0.625Al'. Same layout and legend; oscillating low-amplitude DOS beyond about +/-5 eV.

Labelled 'g Fe': the only panel for elemental Fe. Legend contains only Fe-s, Fe-p, Fe-d and total up/down states - no Al or Mn terms. Up-states peak near the Fermi level at about the 1.8 gridline; Fe-d dominates, Fe-s and Fe-p are near zero.
Labelled 'h Fe0.25Mn0.75Al'. Same layout and legend as (c); sharp Fermi-level peak with the Mn-d partial now relatively more prominent.
Labelled 'i Fe0.125Mn0.875Al'. Same layout; sharp peak on the Fermi level, deep negative down-state peak.
Labelled 'j MnAl'. Same layout but with no Fe-d term visible in the plotted partials; legend lists Up-Al-s, Up-Al-p, Up-Mn-d and Down-Al-s, Down-Al-p, Down-Mn-d with the total up/down states curves.
